 * side.

variables.name: SUBMENU_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.comment:
* Delay between hovering over a menu item with a mouse and receiving
     * side-effects (ex. opening a sub-menu or closing unrelated menus).

variables.name: mPendingMenus
variables.comment: List of menus that were added before this popup was shown.

variables.name: mShowingMenus
variables.comment:
* List of open menus. The first item is the root menu and each
     * subsequent item is a direct submenu of the previous item.

variables.name: mShouldCloseImmediately
variables.comment: Whether popup menus should disable exit animations when closing.
